title: Brucellosis
description: Zoonotic Brucella infection from unpasteurised dairy or livestock contact; undulant/relapsing fever, drenching sweats, back pain, arthralgia — often mimics typhoid.
source: WHO ICD-11 MMS, block 'Certain zoonotic bacterial diseases' (1B95 Brucellosis). https://icd.who.int/browse11 — verified via https://www.findacode.com/icd-11/code-730510331.html

title: Relapsing fever
description: Borrelia infection transmitted by ticks or lice; recurring febrile episodes separated by afebrile intervals, headache, myalgia — a real differential for cyclical-fever presentations otherwise defaulted to malaria.
source: WHO ICD-11 MMS (1C1J Relapsing fever), listed under 'Certain zoonotic bacterial diseases' block. https://icd.who.int/browse11

title: Anthrax
description: Bacillus anthracis infection via inhalation, ingestion, or cutaneous contact with infected livestock/hides; cutaneous form presents as a painless black-eschar lesion, distinct from ordinary cellulitis.
source: WHO ICD-11 MMS (1B97 Anthrax). https://icd.who.int/browse11 — verified via https://www.findacode.com/icd-11/code-1321303663.html

title: Rabies
description: Rabies virus infection following an animal bite/scratch (commonly dog); prodromal fever and headache progressing to hydrophobia, agitation, or paralysis — a time-critical exposure history to screen for.
source: WHO ICD-11 MMS (1C82 Rabies). https://icd.who.int/browse11 — verified via https://www.findacode.com/icd-11/code-854762584.html

title: Visceral leishmaniasis
description: Leishmania donovani infection transmitted by sandfly bite; prolonged biphasic fever, weight loss, pancytopenia, and marked hepatosplenomegaly — a differential for prolonged undifferentiated fever alongside typhoid and TB.
source: WHO ICD-11 MMS (1F54.0 Visceral leishmaniasis, under 1F54 Leishmaniasis). https://icd.who.int/browse11
